Where to drink in Akihabara? 👇

No.18 · Akihabara after work: two izakaya 🍶

1 · Akatsuka (since 1954): an old wooden izakaya
· Mon–Fri 11:30–13:30, 17:00–22:00 · Sat 17:00–21:00 · closed Sun, holidays, some Sat
· ¥450 cover · lunch cash only, cards at dinner
· Diners love: the old building (12 of 20 recent Tabelog reviews)

2 · Yakiton Sakaba Torahachi: 1 min from JR Akihabara
· Mon–Sat 16:00–23:20 · Sun, hol to 23:00 · open daily except New Year
· No cover charge · cards, IC, QR · Fri & pre-holiday tables 2.5 h
· Diners love: the pork skewers (10 of 20), the stews (5 of 20)

(Tabelog, Nov 18)

Where to get sweets in Kuramae? 👇

Extra: four sweet stops in Kuramae 🍫 About 15 minutes' walk from Asakusa

① Dandelion Chocolate, Sweets TOKYO Hyakumeiten 2026: bean-to-bar chocolate and chocolate drinks · open daily 10:00–19:00 · cards OK
② Clair de Lune: cakes · cafe 9:00–18:00 (LO 17:30) · VISA, JCB, IC, PayPay
③ Kissaten Hangetsu: cream puffs; morning menu 9:00–11:30 · open daily to 19:00 · cash only
④ Kuramae Cannele: canelés · closed Mon · cards OK

What diners love, from the 20 latest Tabelog reviews of each: Cannele's canelés (15 of 20), Clair de Lune's cakes (14 of 20), Hangetsu's cream puffs (12 of 20).
